description: Paraphrase TEST set (15 questions) written after the rule planner was frozen and never used while developing it. Reported separately from the 30-question development set.

queries.question: Name the zone with the highest ginger output in 2025-26
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='ginger' AND l.level='agri_zone' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: Across the three districts, where was the most land under coconut in 2024-25?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='coconut' AND l.level='district' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: Which island reported the most poultry in 2024-25?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='poultry_count' AND o.commodity_id IS NULL AND l.level='island' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: Which zone grew the least maize in 2025-26?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='maize' AND l.level='agri_zone' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY value ASC

queries.question: Arecanut area over the years for the Union Territory
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='arecanut' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: Track the potato retail price between January 2024 and December 2025
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='retail_price' AND o.commodity_id='potato' AND o.location_id='MKT_AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.period_start>='2024-01-01' AND o.period_start<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: When did onion hit its highest price between January 2023 and December 2025?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MAX(o.value) AS value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='retail_price' AND o.commodity_id='onion' AND o.location_id='MKT_AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.period_start BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY value DESC

queries.question: Banana production of A&N from 2019-20 to 2024-25
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='banana' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.period_start>='2019-01-01' AND o.period_start<='2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: Which report and page did the 2024-25 Nicobar district coconut production come from?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='coconut' AND o.location_id='AN_NIC' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: Give the source table for the 2025-26 ginger production of the UT
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='ginger' AND o.location_id='AN' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: Where did the 2024-25 Car Nicobar Island farmer count come from?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='farmers_count' AND o.commodity_id IS NULL AND o.location_id='ISL_CARNICOBAR' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: Do different documents agree on the UT's banana area?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.period_label FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='area_cultivated' AND o.commodity_id='banana' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.period_label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.document_id)>=2)

queries.question: What was the black pepper production of the UT in 2025-26?
